activeTenMinuteFixture.testFixtureOverrides: Aircraft, enemies, and ships had their weapons/reload deadlines disabled during the fixture to prevent terminal combat; this is not normal gameplay.
activeTenMinuteFixture.interpretation: Ten active minutes of deterministic full-roster movement and bounded logical collections; not a ten-minute browser/GPU/performance run.

retries.assertions: Every reset begins at tick 0 with fresh mission ID, zero projectiles, fresh projectile ordinal, zero pool counters, initial roster counts, and unchanged fixed capacities.

forcedPoolExhaustion.assertions: Each emitter records a blocked attempt; projectile counts and shot counters stay zero; ammunition and firing deadlines do not advance. This synthetic guard case is distinct from the zero-blocked natural no-input case.
